data.name: Bond Forged in Blood
data.description: A mauler isn't impressed by fancy words-only furious battle. A mauler can't speak or communicate via language in any way, even if it's a type of creature that normally could.

raw_tokens.value: A mauler isn't impressed by fancy words-only furious battle. A mauler can't speak or communicate via language in any way, even if it's a type of creature that normally could.

Whenever the mauler's master drops a foe whose Hit Dice are at least half its level to below 0 hit points, the mauler's empathic link surges with power, granting both the mauler and its master a +2 morale bonus on attack and damage rolls for 1 round.|PREVARGTEQ:MasterLevel,5
